intent: A stitched-doll gothic lolita gown of deep black with blood-crimson bows, bone lace and cross-stitched patches, cut for the blocky toy body so it reads from the high camera as a narrow laced bodice over a full tiered skirt, with hanging bell sleeves and a lopsided crown bow.
requests: A scalloped or pointed lace edge piece: with only boxes, wedges, cylinders and balls, the bone lace can only read as a straight band.
A tapered skirt panel: the bell flare has to be stepped from stacked boxes, so the overskirt is chunkier than a sewn cloth tier.
